        Watch the June SCM here

        A Special Council Meeting will be held on Tuesday, 30 June 2026, in the Shire of Dowerin Council Chambers, 13 Cottrell Street, Dowerin, commencing at 4.00pm.

        Special Council Meeting 6 July 2023

        Thursday, July 6, 2023 - 03:00 PM

        Location: Council Chambers of the Shire Administration Office, 13 Cottrell Street, Dowerin

        A Special Meeting of Council will be held in Council Chambers, 13 Cottrell Street Dowerin commencing at 3.00pm on Tuesday 6 July 2023.

        The purpose of the meeting is to consider matters affecting an employee.

        Note, it is intended that the meeting be closed to the public, when the matters are considered by Council, in accordance with s5.23 (a) of the Local Government Act 1995.

        Rebecca McCall

        Chief Executive Officer

        Date 22 June 2023

        Council Meetings & Minutes

        Council conducts its Ordinary Meetings on the third Tuesday of each month commencing at 2.00pm in the Council Chambers.  The meetings are open to the public and community members are encouraged to attend. If confidential topics are to be discussed, in accordance with Section 5.23 of the Local Government Act 1995, a portion of the meeting may be held Behind Closed Doors and be closed to members of the community.
